dedupe_keys.name: infraestructura vial y estado de carreteras dominican republic road inventory and maintenance mopc open data

description: The Dominican Ministry of Public Works and Communications (MOPC) publishes on the national open data portal a table of roads it maintains with their latest maintenance date. The dataset page read on 2026-09-28 says the table covers records from October 2025 to June 2026 and gives for each road its name, road type, length in kilometres, date of the last maintenance carried out, municipality, province and sector; it is version 1.0, created on 16 January 2026 and updated on 17 September 2026, with a quarterly frequency and files in CSV, ODS and XLSX, prepared by the ministry's road maintenance unit. Coverage is national. Access is free, under the Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: despite its title the table records maintenance dates, not a graded pavement condition, it has no geometry, so roads must be matched by name, and it covers only roads the ministry maintained in the period. It supports road network inventories and maintenance-based condition proxies for resilience studies of Dominican roads. No related Dominican road record is catalogued.
